# ADITYA.OS

> Personal portfolio of Aditya Kumar Jha, a Computer Science & Engineering student and developer based in Ranchi, Jharkhand, India. His work spans full-stack web development, data analytics, AI/ML, and problem solving.

## Portfolio

- [ADITYA.OS](https://aditya-os-portfolio.vercel.app/): Interactive portfolio and professional profile.
- [Resume](https://aditya-os-portfolio.vercel.app/Aditya%20Resume.pdf): Downloadable resume.

## About Aditya

- B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student.
- Focused on full-stack development, applied AI/ML, and data analytics.
- Interested in competitive programming, system design, and building useful tools.
- Available for opportunities.

## Skills

- Languages: C, C++, Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP.
- Frontend: HTML, CSS, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap.
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Django, FastAPI, Laravel.
- Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLite.
- Data and AI: SQL, Power BI, data analytics, TensorFlow, and applied AI/ML.
- Cloud and tools: AWS, GCP, Vercel, Netlify, Docker, Git, GitHub, and GitHub Actions.

## Selected Projects

- [TechPulse Daily](https://github.com/technical-aditya-rathore/TechPulse-Daily): React technology news platform focused on fast scanning, readability, and external API integrations.
- [Project AstroScope](https://github.com/technical-aditya-rathore/Project-AstroScope-Console-Based-Astrology-App): Python console application using structured, rule-based logic.
- [Scientific Calculator](https://github.com/technical-aditya-rathore/Scientific-Calculator): Java calculator for advanced mathematical operations and precision-focused computation.
- [CODXO Internship Project](https://github.com/technical-aditya-rathore/CODXO-project): JavaScript project completed during a software development internship.
